findings.assessment: Snapshot import versus periodically retrieved subscription is kept distinct. Reimport wording says can add records, not that duplicates are inevitable. No automatic two-way or editing rights are implied.

Recipient-provider refresh dependency matches Microsoft. Intermediary and receiving-client refresh are correctly separated as an architectural inference, without a guaranteed delay or instant-delivery claim.

Correctly compares the same occurrence, event zone and display zone, including seasonal changes. Does not diagnose all offsets as formatting bugs or suggest shifting the shared original to compensate for a receiving display.

Export addition explicitly distinguishes password-free service use from disclosure of supplied calendar content, requires permission to share, and rejects publishing work calendars to bypass restrictions. No no-logs, security, automatic correction, or deletion promise added.

Export expansion adds a useful route decision, bounded source/recipient comparison, two refresh stages and feed disclosure check. Time-zone expansion is narrower than the inherited generic support section and adds recurrence/source/feed-processing decision logic. Neither is a thin conversion-service promotional addition.

findings.suggestion: Replace “while a subscription follows a published source” with “while a subscription periodically retrieves its source feed”.
findings.reason: Avoids readers equating every subscription with public calendar publication; not a factual blocker in context.

findings.suggestion: After the feed-processing sentence, add “A service can receive the calendar content supplied through a private feed even if it does not ask for your account password.” Alternatively, link explicitly to the export guide’s disclosure check.
findings.reason: The standalone time-zone page currently says to review access/data handling but leaves the exact exposure less concrete than the export page. Existing wording is cautious, not a false privacy claim.

findings.suggestion: If tightening for length, keep source/recipient/recurrence diagnosis in the new section and reserve app/iOS versions, sensitive details and no account reset for the final section.
findings.reason: Some bounded comparison/support language repeats, but the additional feed-specific decision makes the section useful.
